items.title: Anthropic Introduces Natural Language Autoencoders That Convert Claude’s Internal Activations Directly into Human-Readable Text Explanations
items.summary:

These activations are, in effect, where the model’s “thinking” lives. The problem is nobody can easily read them. […]
